paper_metadata.title: Tailoring grain and intermetallic of as-extruded Al-La-Mg-Fe alloy: Towards a balance of mechanical properties at room and elevated temperatures
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: This study successfully develops a novel Al-La-Mg-Fe alloy with a balance of room-temperature and high-temperature mechanical properties through precise control of grain structure and intermetallics via hot extrusion process.
